bitcoin_core.why: latest tagged release at the time the harness was written; the coin-selection algorithms are used as-is, with only the instrumentation patch in patches/ applied

coin_select.describes: evanlinjin#5: iterative deepening on the bound, on by default where the problem has unconfirmed ancestors, on top of evanlinjin#4's flat per-node cost and PRs #76, #75 and #73
coin_select.why: the ancestor-aware selection work this benchmark exists to measure, with everything the benchmark has since argued for applied: depth-first traversal (#73), per-candidate ancestor sets stored flat rather than as one dense bitset each (#75), a second greedy prefix ordered by (value - own bump) / weight kept whenever the metric scores it better (#76), a per-node cost that no longer grows with the pool (evanlinjin#4), and iterative deepening on the bound (evanlinjin#5). The last two are unmerged drafts, which is the point of pinning them: this matrix is the evidence for them, so it should be run against them. `Changeless` and `LowestFeeChangeless` are still gone with #73, so the harness runs the wallet track alone
